description: This file contains Redux action creators and related types for handling error logging and error state management in the Mattermost web application.

methods.name: dismissError
methods.description: Creates an action to dismiss an error at a specific index.

methods.name: getLogErrorAction
methods.description: Creates an action to log an error with optional display flag.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Asynchronously logs an error, optionally sending it to the server and displaying an error bar based on options.

methods.name: shouldShowErrorBar
methods.description: Determines whether to show the error bar based on state and options.

methods.name: clearErrors
methods.description: Creates an action to clear all errors.
